lines.t: (Intro)
I hear the echo of grace in the silence,
A heartbeat steady through my violence.
Every broken word still finds its place,
In the mercy that rewrites my faith.
(Verse 1)
I was chasing clouds that never stayed,
Painting dreams that slowly decayed.
But every time I gave in to the gray,
You pulled me back where truth remains.
(Pre-Chorus)
When I stumble, You don’t let go,
I see Your light beneath below.
(Chorus)
You are the fire that breaks my chains,
The calm within a storm of flames.
When everything fades and dreams betray,
You’re the light that never fades.
Where echoes tried to drown my cry.
Yet in my weakness, I was found,
Grace rose stronger than the sound.
(Pre-Chorus 2)
Fear was the prison, love was the key,
Opening doors that set me free.
(Chorus)
You are the fire that breaks my chains,
The calm within a storm of flames.
When everything fades and dreams betray,
You’re the light that never fades.
(Bridge)
Even when night takes all my sight,
I know Your breath ignites the fight.
I’ve fallen down, yet still I rise,
Held by hands that lift the skies.
(Soft break)
All the noise fades when You speak peace,
My restless heart finally released.
(Verse 3)
I’ve wrestled doubt, I’ve faced the pain,
I’ve called for hope in endless rain.
Yet every tear became a flame,
Revealing love I can’t explain.
(Final Chorus)
You are the fire that breaks my chains,
The calm within a storm of flames.
When I forget, Your mercy stays,
My light that never fades.
(Outro)
I don’t need sight to find the way,
I feel it burn in my soul’s display.
Shadows fall but can’t invade,
The light that never fades.
